description: Rename the site slug (hostname {slug}.dotsy.site). Owner-only; use the returned slug afterwards. Published site: the old slug redirects on the API (301 reads, 308 writes) and the old host 301s, both reserved until delete or rename-back. Never published: the old slug 404s and its hostname is released (create_site can reuse it). Stored HTML URLs are not rewritten (use find_replace).
name: rename_site
